LanguageData.LP_AbyssalTaint.label: abyssal taint
LanguageData.LP_AbyssalTaint.description: A stain the Abyss has left on this person's soul. Whispers (10%): mood -3, melee +3%. Shadow (30%): melee +6%, pain threshold +10%, social impact -10%, divine favor from praying to good gods halved. Demon mark (60%): small horns grow, eyes turn red, fire damage ×0.8, occasional abyssal frenzy, no longer fades naturally. Fallen (90%): becomes a demon at 100%.
LanguageData.LP_AbyssalTaint.stages.0.label: latent
LanguageData.LP_AbyssalTaint.stages.1.label: whispers
LanguageData.LP_AbyssalTaint.stages.2.label: shadow
LanguageData.LP_AbyssalTaint.stages.3.label: demon mark
LanguageData.LP_AbyssalTaint.stages.4.label: fallen
LanguageData.LP_AbyssFavored.label: abyss-favored
LanguageData.LP_AbyssFavored.description: Fully embraced the Abyss: +10% damage. Aasimar feel uneasy seeing it.
LanguageData.LP_TaintedPhylactery.label: tainted phylactery
LanguageData.LP_TaintedPhylactery.description: The stain of the Abyss has seeped into the phylactery: time needed to revive ×1.5.
LanguageData.LP_SoulMortgaged.label: soul mortgage
LanguageData.LP_SoulMortgaged.description: This person's soul is mortgaged to the Abyss: cannot be resurrected after death, and the corpse turns to black smoke. Can be redeemed from a good god at an altar (30 divine favor).
LanguageData.LP_PlanarBinding.label: planar binding
LanguageData.LP_PlanarBinding.description: An outsider tied to this world by an abyssal ritual; the number in brackets is obedience (0-100). Obedience drops every day; at 0 it breaks free and joins the abyssal horde. The master reaffirming its true name, putting its bed in a binding circle and holding its true name scroll all keep it obedient. Bound ones do not age and are not banished when knocked down; on death the body turns to black smoke and returns to the Abyss.
LanguageData.LP_AbyssThrall.label: abyssal servant
LanguageData.LP_AbyssThrall.description: A timed summoned servant: obeys orders, can be drafted, has no mood, does not count toward raid points, and no one mourns its death. It is banished when time runs out.
LanguageData.LP_PlanarShackled.label: planar anchor chain
LanguageData.LP_PlanarShackled.description: Shackles of anchoring runes lock it to this plane: it is not banished when downed and can be captured; it leaves a corpse when it dies.
LanguageData.LP_RitualStupor.label: abyssal hold
LanguageData.LP_RitualStupor.description: The leader of the abyssal ritual has pinned him in place with an incantation: unable to move.
LanguageData.LP_SuccubusDisguise.label: disguise
